learning_outcomes.text: Learn general definitions and concepts related to mechanical installations.
Understand how to prepare a plumbing project for a building.
Demonstrate the drawing of floor and column diagrams used in plumbing projects.
Perform calculations for clean and wastewater piping diameters.
Perform other calculations related to project planning.
Create detailed drawings of sanitary installation devices.
Design, draw, and calculate mechanical installation projects for a structure based on this information.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Definitions. Mechanical installation topics. Sanitary installations.

Clean water installations. Clean water pipe network design. Distribution types. Clean water installation pipe calculations. Apparatus and fittings. Flow control, valves. Installation connection and assembly parts.

Clean water installations. Clean water pipe network design. Distribution types. Clean water installation pipe calculations. Apparatus and fittings. Flow control, valves. Installation connection and assembly parts.
Freezing, sweating, noise, shock, expansion in clean water installations. Water pressurization, hydrophores. Reserve water tanks.
Hot water installations. Boilers. Exchangers. Thermosiphons.
Wastewater installations. Wastewater pipe network design and calculations. Siphons. Ventilation in wastewater installations. Reservoirs.
Flushometers. Separators. Manholes. Wastewater pits. Sewer pits. Filtration pits. Septic tanks.
Clean water treatment plants. Wastewater treatment plants. Water softening plants.
Fire extinguishing installations. Hydrants, sprinkler systems. Steam and smoke exhaust installations. Chimneys. Rain drainage installations. Garbage chutes. Garbage disposers.
Various installations: Kitchen installations. Laundry room installations. Hospital installations. Waste disposal and waste incineration plants.
City installations: City clean water network. City sewerage network. Park, garden and agricultural irrigation networks. Desalination systems.
